nativeDlssLabCapability.status: native-scale feature creation proven; Endfield parity not proven
nativeDlssLabCapability.boundary: The public Unity wrapper has no DLAA enum and feature creation does not establish Endfield's exact Streamline schedule, motion/depth/reactive inputs, jitter, reset policy, executed output, or frame-generation path. This is an implementation-feasibility result only.

nativeStreamlineRuntimeContract.status: pinned custom Streamline DLAA schedule, tags, constants, options, evaluate call, velocity conversion, reset producer, and default native-scale extent recovered; combined-motion storage format remains incomplete
nativeStreamlineRuntimeContract.implementation: The installed client uses custom UnityPlayer Streamline render-graph code, not UnityEngine.NVIDIAModule's public ExecuteDLSS contract.
nativeStreamlineRuntimeContract.tagContract: All five tags use eOnlyValidNow with extent (0,0,native texture width,native texture height). The DLSS path contains no ReactiveMaskHint or TransparencyAndCompositionMaskHint. The optional HG UI hint is separately tagged UIColorAndAlpha for UI/frame generation and is not a DLSS reactive input.

constants.matrixConvention: five row-major matrices, explicitly de-jittered upstream
constants.jitterOffset: negative source camera jitter on both axes, in pixel space
constants.reset: prevTransformReset produced in HGCamera.Update and applied through slSetConstants for the same frame token as evaluation

resetProducer.equation: prevTransformReset = IsLargeCameraMovement(mainViewConstants, camera-derived threshold, 0.22303554) || isFirstFrame; isFirstFrame is then cleared in the same HGCamera.Update
resetProducer.largeMovement: Compares old/current de-jittered transforms and returns true for rotational/FOV-derived or position-threshold excess.
resetProducer.resetMethod: HGCamera.Reset sets isFirstFrame, prevTransformReset, cameraFrameCount zero, and the antialiasing/history state byte.
resetProducer.negativeEvidence: Size, antialiasing, and DLSS-mode transitions are not additional direct terms in this compiled boolean. They affect reset only if an external/IFix caller invokes Reset or sets isFirstFrame, or movement independently crosses the threshold.

renderScale.managedPolicy: When DLSS is supported, UpdateRenderingScale calls DLSSOptimalSettings.GetDLSSOptimalSetting(quality, outputSize), divides returned optimalRenderWidth by outputWidth, and writes renderingScale when changed.
renderScale.dlaaBoundary: HG quality 4 maps to Streamline mode 6. The installed default callback path maps mode 6 to NGX perf-quality index 5, selects scale 1.0, and returns rounded output dimensions times that scale, so ordinary mode-6 input and output extents are equal. Explicit internal override/profile paths and live feature availability remain outside this static proof.
renderScale.renderGraphExtent: Output viewport sets actualWidth/Height; sceneRTSize is even-clamped actual dimensions times HGUtils.GetRenderingScale.

installedOptimalSettings.modeMapping: PerfQualityValue = Streamline mode - 1; eDLAA mode 6 therefore reaches NGX index 5
installedOptimalSettings.result: optimalRenderWidth=outputWidth and optimalRenderHeight=outputHeight on the installed default callback path

velocityCombine.bindings: b0 CombinedVelocityData with integer extent bit patterns in _InputExtentData.xy; t0 _Velocity; u0 _CombinedVelocity
velocityCombine.output: new full-input-resolution combined velocity texture tagged as Streamline motion vectors
velocityCombine.equation: For each packed p in source xy, decode(p)=sign(p-0.5)*(2*abs(p)-1)^4. Store float4(decode(x),decode(y),decode(x),decode(x)); only xy are semantic and z/w may be discarded by a two-channel UAV.
velocityCombine.unusedInputs: The selected D3D kernel declares no depth SRV and performs no depth or matrix calculation. Depth/matrix data visible in the broader native scheduling path do not enter this kernel.
velocityCombine.qualifiedProducerComposition: For the recovered CharacterNPR producer p=0.5+0.5*sign(d)*abs(0.5*d)^0.25, composition yields 0.5*d: half current-minus-previous non-jittered NDC X and negative half current-minus-previous non-jittered NDC Y, which is viewport/UV-fraction motion consistent with Streamline mvecScale (1,1). Direct attachment of every renderer's producer to this exact _Velocity binding is not yet proven.
velocityCombine.streamlineSideConvention: combined camera-plus-object motion already normalized; mvecScale remains (1,1)

storageFormats.packedInputSceneMv: GraphicsFormat.A2B10G10R10_UNormPack32 (public enum 75 / 0x4b; DXGI_FORMAT_R10G10B10A2_UNORM), full-resolution, Point/Repeat, no random write, neutral clear (0.5,0.5,0,0)

velocityCombine.correctedLiteralAttribution: Native descriptor literal 0x2d maps exactly to GraphicsFormat.R16_SFloat / DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT, but the pinned writer is TAAUPassConstructor.ConstructDilationPass and uses it for dilated depth. It is not evidence for _CombinedVelocity.

allocationFormatAudit.result: not statically recoverable from the pinned retail binary and matching stock Unity symbols
allocationFormatAudit.stockSymbolBoundary: The Unity 2022.3.62f3 nondevelopment Mono player PDB has no RenderGraph or TextureDesc symbols and no usable UDT, enum, or typedef records. No credible stock equivalent of the retail helper was found; the helper is consistent with a HyperGryph fork addition.
allocationFormatAudit.literalBoundary: The caller later supplies 0x2d to an unidentified virtual method at vtable offset 0x700. The concrete vtable and enum domain are not statically materialized, so numeric coincidence cannot identify GraphicsFormat, DXGI_FORMAT, or RenderTextureFormat.
allocationFormatAudit.minimalRuntimeProbe: Break at UnityPlayer.dll+0x12819f8 on a DLSS frame, resolve the concrete vtable target, follow the allocation to D3D12 resource creation, and inspect D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC.Format at descriptor offset 0x20; PIX or RenderDoc inspection of velocity-combine UAV u0 is equivalent.

taauRuntimeContract.historyGate: Scene-color, dilated-depth, and dilated-SceneMV histories must all be valid, and TAAU must have been enabled on the preceding frame. Otherwise effective history weight is zero and firstFrame is one.
taauRuntimeContract.implementedSubset: The compatibility path runs Dilation's recovered 3x3 reversed-Z winner scan, exact fourth-root SceneMV decode, previous-non-jittered-VP reprojection, previous dilated-depth/SceneMV lookup, and exact B/Z-lane flag repacking into persistent auxiliary histories. It also runs exact MaskDilation into an R8 current-frame resource: maximum packed B/Z over the center and four diagonals, then one iff the maximum is positive. The complete decoded ordinary Quality-0 consumer math is available only through ENDFIELD_RECOVERED_TAAU_PACKED_RESOLVE=1; the canonical path deliberately retains the earlier raw-lane partial consumer because capture-time admission and state inputs remain open and the bounded experiment strongly regresses the reference.

quality0ResolveConsumer.shaderStatus: no-keyword D3D11 math decoded and implemented behind an explicit experiment gate
quality0ResolveConsumer.packedBit1: The normalized 10-bit SceneMV B lane is rounded, bit 1 selects center versus normalized 3x3 stddev-1 Gaussian current color, and the same bit contributes to responsive rejection.
quality0ResolveConsumer.historyPolicy: Five-tap Catmull-Rom history is reconstructed in compressed RGB, bounded to 0.2x..1.8x the direct reprojected history sample, then variance-clipped in the recovered YCoCg basis unless confidence is valid.
quality0ResolveConsumer.confidencePolicy: Dilated-mask clear state, responsive risk, bounds, first-frame, large-motion, class-0.6, fast-converge, neighborhood topology, and 0.9 times prior history alpha produce confidence. Confidence is stored in history alpha and must not become display opacity.
quality0ResolveConsumer.presentationSeparation: The experiment keeps exact RGBA in the persistent history, then copies resolved RGB to beauty with opaque alpha because the lab's later compatibility Uber interprets source alpha as presentation opacity.

taauRuntimeContract.firstFrameSeedBoundary: The retail auxiliary texture allocation/clear payload is not recovered. The compatibility pass uses deterministic depth 0 and SceneMV (0.5,0.5,0,0) only while its explicit auxiliary-history-valid gate is false; the recovered managed history gate independently makes scene-color history weight zero on that first frame.
taauRuntimeContract.explicitBoundary: The ordinary Quality-0 shader math is implemented for bounded experimentation, but capture-specific jitter/frame state, live convergence and responsive lanes, first-allocation history payload, live IFix selection, and TAAU admission remain unproven. The packed auxiliary SceneMV and mask are therefore not consumed by the canonical beauty path. The recovered managed base branch does not prove live CharInfo IFix activation or override the stronger DLSS/DLAA selection evidence.
